origin.description: Explicit Euler step. When improved is true, that prediction is replaced by the trapezoidal Heun average.
origin.usage: euler_heun(f, a, b, y0, n = 100, improved = TRUE, ...)

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Derivative y' = f(t, y), returning one value.

arguments.name: improved
arguments.text: TRUE uses the Heun correction. FALSE keeps Euler.

origin.details: y' = -y, y(0) = 1, eight Heun steps on [0, 0.5].
origin.value: Explicit Euler step. When improved is true, that prediction is replaced by the trapezoidal Heun average.
